blocks.text: ALV Pageant Circle made another game of musical chairs with a national title finding a new queen. Rizal beauty Beatriz Angela Ocampo will now be representing the Philippines at the 2026 Face of Beauty International pageant in Taiwan. The national pageant arm of talent manager and entrepreneur Arnold Vegafria made the announcement on social media, saying the former titleholder Olivia Grace Reilly decided to abdicate the throne. “We respect Olivia’s decision and wish her all the best in her future pageant journeys,” the statement said. Reilly represented Sultan Kudarat at the 2026 Miss World Philippines pageant in February. She was crowned […]...
